title: Teach the leader to route to a situation
action: Update the doctrine to the situation router (decision 41bbba68). packages/bee/LEADER.md § Route each task: after `bee orient --class <c>`, pick the situation whose trigger phrases match the task from the situation lines it prints, open that situation file, and seed the todo list from its numbered steps; when no situation fits, or the work is large and cross-cutting, use bee-figure-it-out; a session situation (pick up, pause, run until done, orchestrate, babysit, ship) comes from skills/bee-planning/playbooks/session/index.md and binds no class. Add to § Trigger index one line per new skill a leader reaches by situation (bee-architect, bee-arena, bee-interrogate, bee-fanout, bee-tdd, bee-show-me-your-work, bee-reflect, bee-recall, bee-blast-radius, bee-comment-review, bee-figure-it-out), pointing, never restating. In skills/bee-planning/SKILL.md and planning-reference.md § Playbooks, the plan cites the situation file skills/bee-planning/playbooks/<class>/<situation>.md, and the class index only for a class with no situations. In skills/bee-hive/references/routing-and-contracts.md, the todo list seeds from the situation's steps. Name no principle in any of these surfaces (decision a6e3d0bf). Copy packages/bee/LEADER.md to .bee/LEADER.md byte for byte, run bee dev regen, and commit. Bee commands you may run in this cell: cargo test, `.bee/bin/bee dev regen`, `.bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check`, `.bee/bin/bee knowledge check`, `.bee/bin/bee knowledge consolidate`, `.bee/bin/bee onboard --repo-root . --json`, and `bee herding notify`. Never run `bee dispatch` or any of its `--help`. Round 2: commit ecf77d86c already landed the doctrine changes above; keep them. The one red is pointer_integrity: skills/bee-researching/references/trace-and-provenance.md:129 points at references/lead-judgment.md, which lives at skills/bee-interrogate/references/lead-judgment.md. Fix that pointer in the form the pointer test accepts, run bee dev regen, rerun the verify, commit, and cap.
